Terms of use

Scope

These terms apply to Zucchini Wallet and the Zucchini project website, gateway and registry. By using these services, you agree to these terms and the privacy policy. Contact the Zucchini project at x@zucchinifi.xyz with questions. Open-source software remains subject to its applicable license.

Self-custody and your responsibility

You control your wallet and approve transactions. Zucchini does not hold your recovery phrase or wallet private keys and cannot recover lost recovery material, reverse blockchain transactions or guarantee recovery of funds. Check recipient identity, address, network, amount, fees and any memo before approving. Protect your device, password and backups.

Registry and social tipping

The registry verifies control of a social account and records a receiving address; it does not guarantee the real-world identity, trustworthiness or continued control of that account. Registration is optional and creates an identity-to-address association. Update or disconnect a binding through fresh verification when needed. A failed lookup is not proof that someone is unregistered. Invitation drafts are yours to review and submit; Zucchini does not post them automatically.

Third-party services and fees

RPC operators, explorers, X, Peer, payment services and swap providers operate independently and may apply their own terms, eligibility rules, limits and fees. Quotes can expire; settlement, refunds and availability depend on the relevant provider and network. Review any disclosed network, provider and Zucchini fees before proceeding. Zucchini is not a bank, does not insure deposits and does not provide investment advice.

Privacy and permitted use

We do not sell or rent user data or use it for advertising, behavioral profiling, data brokerage or AI training. Necessary service processing and sharing are described in our privacy policy. Do not use the services to impersonate account holders, submit false ownership claims, access others’ wallets, disrupt infrastructure or violate applicable law. Access to gateway services may be restricted to address abuse or operational threats; this does not transfer control of your wallet keys to us.

Availability and changes

Software and network services can contain defects, be interrupted or change. No specific uptime, transaction outcome, asset value or future feature is guaranteed. To the extent permitted by applicable law, software and services are provided as available without additional warranties. Nothing in these terms excludes rights or liabilities that cannot lawfully be excluded. Service changes and updated terms will be published here; material changes affecting an active feature will be communicated as appropriate.

Contact

Contact x@zucchinifi.xyz for support or questions about these terms. Never send recovery phrases, passwords or private keys. The privacy policy explains device-data removal, registry disconnection and service-side deletion requests.

Website payment requests

Connecting a website grants only the permissions you approve. Review the requesting origin, recipient, amount, memo and fee before approving each payment. Ordinary ZIP-321 requests do not authenticate merchant identity or guarantee delivery of goods or services. A submitted transaction identifier is not proof of a confirmed merchant receipt. Signed merchant registry payments are not enabled in the production 0.5.2 extension.
